notebook: PLAN: Recover high-value blends with a compact train: root C5/C6 split; polish overhead to a C5 blend by rejecting C4 and lighter; split root bottoms into C6 paraffin and naphthene/heavy products. Step 3: restore a convergent three-column baseline, then sharpen selectively. The severe 90-stage root failed; revert to the best valid root (-0.469) and use balanced 60-stage child columns. Prior best three-column plant had TB 72% C5 and BT 81% C6 paraffin. Root must retain almost no C5 in bottoms, and T must reject C4. C5 blend ~$618M/yr, C6 paraffin ~$1.2B/yr, C6 naphthene ~$396M/yr.
